Message.Name: Clear Quote Message
Message.Description: The Clear Quote message instructs feed recipients to clear all quotes and Summary and/or ADAP information for the specified symbol on the specified market(s).

Field.Name: Last Update Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the last matching engine message that updated the quote information for this symbol in the Cboe One server's cache. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight (effective 11/02/26, since epoch).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Market Center
Field.Description: * = All Cboe Markets for this feed Y=BYX Z=BZX A=EDGA X=EDGX

Message.Name: Fractional Symbol Summary Message
Message.Description: The Fractional Symbol Summary message delivers the Cboe consolidated best bid/offer and total executed volume across all applicable Cboe One US Exchanges.

Field.Name: Last Update Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the last matching engine message that updated the quote information for this symbol in the Cboe One server's cache. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight (effective 11/02/26, since epoch).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Cboe Cumulative Executed Volume
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares traded today across all applicable Cboe books.

Field.Name: Consolidated Best Bid Price
Field.Description: Cboe Consolidated best bid price.

Field.Name: Consolidated Best Bid Quantity
Field.Description: Cboe Consolidated number of buy-side shares available for this symbol.

Field.Name: Consolidated Best Ask Price
Field.Description: Cboe Consolidated best ask price.

Field.Name: Consolidated Best Ask Quantity
Field.Description: Cboe Consolidated number of sell-side shares available for this symbol.

Field.Name: National Cumulative Volume
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares traded today as reported to the CTA and UTP SIPs.

Field.Name: Fractional Symbol Summary Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 :National Volume Status 0 :National volume data is complete 1 :National volume data may not be complete due to an unrecoverable gap on the incoming feed Bit 1-7 :Reserved

Message.Name: Best Quote Update Message
Message.Description: The Best Quote Update message is used to update one side of the Cboe consolidated quote information for a symbol.

Field.Name: Last Update Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the last matching engine message that updated the quote information for this symbol in the Cboe One server's cache. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight (effective 11/02/26, since epoch).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B=Buy Side S=Sell Side

Field.Name: Consolidated Best Quote Price
Field.Description: Cboe Consolidated best price.

Field.Name: Consolidated Quote Quantity
Field.Description: Cboe Consolidated number of shares available for this symbol.

Message.Name: Cboe Market Status Message
Message.Description: The Cboe Market Status message is disseminated to reflect a change in the status of a market.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of when the Market Status changed for the specified Market Center. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight (effective 11/02/26, since epoch).

Field.Name: Market Center
Field.Description: Y=BYX Z=BZX A=EDGA X=EDGX

Field.Name: Market Status
Field.Description: N=Normal E=Excluded from Symbol Summary and ADAP updates I=Incomplete

Field.Name: Session Indicator
Field.Description: R=Regular trading session P=Pre- or post-market session

Message.Name: ADAP Message
Message.Description: Each ADAP message delivers one or more updates for a Symbol's ADAP book. Each ADAP message contains one or more ADAP Block messages.

Field.Name: Last Update Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the last matching engine message that updated the quote information for this symbol in the Cboe One server's cache. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight (effective 11/02/26, since epoch).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: ADAP Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 :Clear ADAP 0 :Keep any ADAP information for this symbol. 1 :Delete any ADAP information for this symbol before applying ADAP Block messages Bit 1 :ADAP Complete 0 :The ADAP view for this symbol is complete. 1 :More ADAP updates for this symbol to follow in another ADAP message. Bit 2 :Short/Long Block(s) 0 :Short Update ADAP Block message(s) to follow 1 :Long Update ADAP Block message(s) to follow Bit 3-7 :Reserved

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: ADAP Blocks
Field.Description: Number of ADAP Block message to follow

Field.Name: ADAP Block Size
Field.Description: Size of each ADAP Block message

Field.Name: ADAP Block
Field.Description: Total Length = Variable (Header Length [22 bytes] + ADAP Blocks x ADAP Block Size)

Message.Name: RPI Message
Message.Description: The Retail Price Improvement (RPI) message is a retail liquidity indicator that includes symbol and side, but not price and size.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the matching engine RPI message emitted by the specified Market Center. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight (effective 11/02/26, since epoch).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Market Center
Field.Description: Y=BYX Z=BZX A=EDGA X=EDGX

Field.Name: Retail Price Improvement
Field.Description: B=Buy Side RPI S=Sell Side RPI A=Buy & Sell RPI N=No RPI

Message.Name: Fractional Trade Message
Message.Description: Fractional Trade messages are sent when an order is executed in whole or in part on a Cboe exchange.

Field.Name: Transaction Time
Field.Description: The time the trade occurred on the specified Market Center. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight (effective 11/02/26, since epoch).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Market Center
Field.Description: Market Center on which the last trade was executed: Y=BYX Z=BZX A=EDGA X=EDGX

Field.Name: Market Center Execution ID
Field.Description: Market center specific execution identifier of this Execution. Execution ID is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Last Price
Field.Description: Last trade price.

Field.Name: Last Quantity
Field.Description: Last trade quantity.

Field.Name: Cboe Cumulative Executed Volume
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares traded today across all applicable books.

Field.Name: National Cumulative Volume
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares traded today as reported to the CTA and UTP SIPs.

Field.Name: Fractional Trade Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 :National Volume Status 0 :National volume data is complete. 1 :National volume data may not be complete due to an unrecoverable gap on the incoming feed. Bit 1 :Last-Sale Eligible 0 :Trade is not last-sale eligible 1 :Trade is last-sale eligible Bit 2-7 :Reserved

Message.Name: Fractional Trade Break Message
Message.Description: The Fractional Trade Break message is sent whenever an execution on a Cboe exchange is broken.

Field.Name: Transaction Time
Field.Description: The time the trade break occurred on the specified Market Center. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight (effective 11/02/26, since epoch).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Market Center
Field.Description: Market Center on which the last trade was executed: Y=BYX Z=BZX A=EDGA X=EDGX

Field.Name: Market Center Execution ID
Field.Description: Market center specific execution identifier of trade to be broken.

Field.Name: Cboe Cumulative Executed Volume
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares traded today across all applicable Cboe books.

Field.Name: National Cumulative Volume
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares traded today as reported to the CTA and UTP SIPs.

Field.Name: Fractional Trade Break Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 :SIP Volume Status 0 :SIP volume data is complete. 1 :SIP volume data may not be complete due to an unrecoverable gap on the incoming feed. Bit 1-7 :Reserved

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: The Trading Status message is used to indicate the current trading status of a security on a Cboe exchange.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the matching engine trading status message emitted by the specified Market Center. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight (effective 11/02/26, since epoch).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Market Center
Field.Description: Y=BYX Z=BZX A=EDGA X=EDGX

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: A=Accepting Orders for Queuing H=Halted Q=Quote-Only S=Exchange Specific Suspension T=Trading

Field.Name: Reg SHO Action
Field.Description: 0=No price test in effect 1=Reg SHO price test restriction in effect

Message.Name: Opening Closing Price Message
Message.Description: The Opening/Closing Price message is used to indicate the Opening or Closing price of a security on any of the Cboe markets and the primary listing market.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time the eligible trade occurred on the specified Market Center. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight (effective 11/02/26, since epoch).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Market Center
Field.Description: Y=BYX Z=BZX A=EDGA X=EDGX C=CTA U=UTP

Field.Name: Open Close Indicator
Field.Description: O=Price is the Opening price C=Price is the Closing price

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Opening/Closing Price.

Message.Name: Fractional End of Day Summary Message
Message.Description: The Fractional End of Day Summary message is used to give a consolidated, high-level overview of a security for the day.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The timestamp of the originating SIP summary message. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight (effective 11/02/26, since epoch).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Data Source
Field.Description: C=CTA U=UTP

Field.Name: Opening Price
Field.Description: Opening Price. 0 if the system has not received an opening price for the security.

Field.Name: Closing Price
Field.Description: Closing Price.

Field.Name: High Price
Field.Description: Highest trade price of the day.

Field.Name: Low Price
Field.Description: Lowest trade price of the day.

Field.Name: National Cumulative Volume
Field.Description: Cumulative volume of shares traded as reported to the national consolidators (SIPs).

Field.Name: ADAP Update
Field.Description: ADAP Block

Field.Name: Market Center
Field.Description: Y=BYX Z=BZX A=EDGA X=EDGX

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: B=Buy Side S=Sell Side

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price level to add/update for Market Center's ADAP book.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity of shares at this price level in the Market Center's ADAP book. A value of zero implies deletion of this ADAP level.

Field.Name: Market Center
Field.Description: Y=BYX Z=BZX A=EDGA X=EDGX

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: B=Buy Side S=Sell Side

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price level to add/update for Market Center's ADAP book.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity of shares at this price level in the Market Center's ADAP book. A value of zero implies deletion of this ADAP level.

Value.Name: All Cboe Markets
Value.Description: All Cboe Markets for this feed
